usage: llm-modelbench reprobe-plan [-h] [--json] [--mock]
                                   [--runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE]
                                   [--runs-dir RUNS_DIR]
                                   [--campaigns-dir CAMPAIGNS_DIR]
                                   [--model MODEL]
                                   [--capability {vision,text,embedding,tools,insert}]
                                   [--backend BACKEND] [--reason REASON]
                                   [--only-required]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --json                write the full machine-readable plan to stdout
  --mock                use offline stub model list
  --runtime-profile RUNTIME_PROFILE
                        saved runtime profile; explicit selection takes
                        precedence
  --runs-dir RUNS_DIR   root directory to scan for capability_report.json
                        (default: runs)
  --campaigns-dir CAMPAIGNS_DIR
                        root directory to scan for campaign evidence (default:
                        campaigns)
  --model MODEL         filter to one model alias
  --capability {vision,text,embedding,tools,insert}
                        filter to one capability family
  --backend BACKEND     filter to one current backend
  --reason REASON       filter to one Stage 2.7A classification bucket (e.g.
                        model_identity_changed)
  --only-required       show only cells that need a reprobe
